cohort: The study followed 167 Chinese pregnant women with medically defined complications and elevated depression screening scores (Edinburgh Postnatal Depression Scale ≥ 9 and/or Postpartum Depression Screening Scale ≥ 60) throughout pregnancy and postpartum.
finding: Postnatal depression at 6-weeks after delivery was significantly associated with depression in late pregnancy, depression at 3-days after delivery, postnatal stress events, postnatal complications, and concerns about the fetus.
